caption:
Same prompt, two models: Qwen 3.8 27B running locally on a MacBook Pro M5 Max (36 GB, Ollama) vs Claude Opus in the cloud. I timed every run, counted every token and added up every cent.

- Test 1, 2D harbour animation: both hit all 7 beats. Qwen 9:48 for $0, Claude 9:57 for $1.32.
- Test 2, 3D voxel island: Qwen's island goes pitch black at night. Claude keeps every requirement, 4:09 vs 11:46, for $0.55.
- Test 3, rooftop runner game: both work on the first try.
- Test 4, messy CSV → Excel report inside Claude Code: both 10/10. Claude finished in 6:22 for $0.31; Qwen kept checking and I stopped it at 33 minutes.

Would you run these on an RTX 5090? Tell me in the comments.
